title: Canonical verification: validation library + health check + 34 behavioral tests + fleet remediation
rationale: Framework went from 'says canonical' to 'proves canonical'. tools/wai_validate.py is the single source of truth for all schema knowledge. tools/spoke_health_check.py validates any spoke. 34 behavioral tests replaced mock-heavy structural tests. 19/19 spokes remediated to HEALTHY including 2 unregistered and the spoke template. Zero retired files remaining (WAI-Signals.jsonl, WAI-Session-Log.jsonl). Spoke template fixed to prevent propagation.
